title: tabernaemontana salomonensis
intro: Tabernaemontana salomonensis, commonly known as the Solomon Islands yellow wood, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in the Pacific Islands to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Tabernaemontana salomonensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and prevent infection. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids such as tabernaemontanine and voacangine, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions, including analgesic and antispasmodic effects.
